title: rpc(5) — RPC program number database

date.notes: manual revision containing historical Sun RPC example

claims_extracted.claim: /etc/rpc maps RPC program names to program numbers and aliases; the manual preserves an example directly identified as coming from the Sun RPC Source distribution, including portmapper=100000 and nfs=100003.

notes: RPC program numbers are not TCP/UDP service port numbers; portmapper/rpcbind mediates program/version/protocol to transport endpoints.
